mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A
WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.status != 'DELETED'
AND A.status = #{status}
AND A.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
ORDER BY A.created_at DESC

SELECT A.*, E.image_path, C.name as sido_name, B.name as sigungu_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetup_applications WHERE meetup_id = A.meetup_id) AS participant, DATE_FORMAT(meetup_At, '%Y.%m.%d') as fomatMeetupAt
FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN sigungus AS B ON B.sigungu_id = A.sigungu_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sidos AS C ON C.sido_id = B.sido_id LEFT OUTER JOIN meetup_images AS D ON D.meetup_id = A.meetup_id LEFT OUTER JOIN images AS E ON E.image_id = D.image_id WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.status != 'DELETED'
AND C.sido_id = #{sidoId}
ORDER BY
A.created_at ASC
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN meetup_likes AS B ON B.meetup_id = A.meetup_id GROUP BY A.meetup_id) DESC
A.meetup_At DESC
A.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{start}, ${end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN sigungus AS B ON B.sigungu_id = A.sigungu_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sidos AS C ON C.sido_id = B.sido_id LEFT OUTER JOIN meetup_images AS D ON D.meetup_id = A.meetup_id LEFT OUTER JOIN images AS E ON E.image_id = D.image_id WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.status != 'DELETED'
AND C.sido_id = #{sidoId}
ORDER BY
A.created_at ASC
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN meetup_likes AS B ON B.meetup_id = A.meetup_id GROUP BY A.meetup_id) DESC
A.meetup_At DESC
A.created_at DESC
SELECT A.*, C.image_path FROM meetups AS A JOIN meetup_images AS B ON B.meetup_id = A.meetup_id JOIN images AS C ON C.image_id = B.image_id WHERE A.meetup_id = ${meetup_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meetup_applications (meetup_id, member_id, status) VAEUE (#{meetup_id}, #{member_id}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE meetups SET title = ${title}, content = ${content}, max_participants = ${max_participants}, min_participants = ${min_participants}, address = ${address}, meetup_datetime = ${meetup_datetime}, status = ${status} WHERE meetup_id = ${meetup_id}
